{"content":"#!/usr/bin/env node

p=p+" sys.exit(1)\n"

p=p+" sys.exit(1)\n"

p=p+"sv[1]=0\n"
p=p+"sq=int(ub**0.5)+1\n"

p=p+"lo=2\n"
p=p+"hi=ub\n"
p=p+"tgt=n\n"
p=p+"while lo<hi:\n"
p=p+" mid=(lo+hi)//2\n"
p=p+" c=sv.count(1,0,mid+1)\n"
p=p+" if c>=tgt:\n"
p=p+"  hi=mid\n"
p=p+" else:\n"
p=p+"  lo=mid+1\n"
p=p+"print(lo)\n"
j=j+"let a=process.argv.slice(2)\n"
j=j+"if(a.length<1){console.error('missing argument');process.exit(1)}\n"
j=j+"let s=a[0]\n"
j=j+"let t=s.trim()\n"
j=j+"if(t===''){console.error('invalid input');process.exit(1)}\n"
j=j+"let u=t\n"
j=j+"if(u[0]==='+'||u[0]==='-'){u=u.slice(1)}\n"
j=j+"if(u===''){console.error('invalid input');process.exit(1)}\n"
j=j+"let ok=true\n"
j=j+"for(let i=0;i<u.length;i++){let c=u[i];if(c<'0'||c>'9'){ok=false;break}}\n"
j=j+"if(!ok){console.error('invalid input');process.exit(1)}\n"
j=j+"let N=Number(t)\n"
j=j+"if(!Number.isSafeInteger(N)||N<0){console.error('invalid input');process.exit(1)}\n"
j=j+"let n=N+1\n"
j=j+"let small=[2,3,5,7,11,13]\n"
j=j+"if(n<=6){console.log(small[N]);process.exit(0)}\n"
j=j+"let ub=Math.floor(n*(Math.log(n)+Math.log(Math.log(n))))+10010\n"
j=j+"let sv=new Uint8Array(ub+1)\n"
j=j+"sv.fill(1)\n"
j=j+"sv[0]=0\n"
j=j+"sv[1]=0\n"
j=j+"let sq=Math.floor(Math.sqrt(ub))\n"
j=j+"for(let i=2;i<=sq;i++){if(sv[i]){for(let k=i*i;k<=ub;k+=i){sv[k]=0}}}\n"
j=j+"let cnt=0\n"
j=j+"let ans=2\n"
j=j+"for(let i=2;i<=ub;i++){if(sv[i]){if(cnt===N){ans=i;break}cnt++}}\n"
j=j+"console.log(ans)\n"
q="exec(p)"
r="eval(j)"
eval([q,r][d])
","path":"/app/solution.py.js"}
